title: Breaking Dawn
author: Stephenie Meyer
current_text: A parent challenged Breaking Dawn at Brockbank Junior High in Magna (UT) over its sexual content, and the book was not put on the library shelves following the complaint.

sources.quote: Challenged at the Brockbank Junior High in Magna (UT) by a parent over sexual content in the author’s fourth novel, Breaking Dawn.
sources.title: Banned Books 2015 – Twilight series – Marshall University Libraries

sources.quote: Reported yesterday in the Salt Lake Tribune, Breaking Dawn, the final book in the Twilight Series has arrived at Brockbank Junior High. So w hy can’t students check it out? Following a parent’s complaint, has not been put on the library shelves.
sources.title: "Breaking Dawn" from Twilight series not on the shelves of Utah school library - National Coalition Against Censorship
